story.voidcraft_awakening.name: Voidcraft: The Sleeper Signal
story.voidcraft.beat00: Emergency systems online. I am VEGA. Your memory is absent. A signal is rising from beneath this world's crust, but no receiver aboard can identify its source.
story.voidcraft.beat01: The signal is not coming from the ruins. The ruins are repeating it, block by block, as though the stone itself were an antenna.
story.voidcraft.beat02: A name survives in the pattern: Veyl. Not a colony, not a species record. A builders' mark older than this star.
story.voidcraft.beat03: The same Veyl geometry exists on worlds that never shared an orbit. Its measurements agree too precisely to be chance.
story.voidcraft.beat04: The ruins continue below every scan limit. I no longer believe they were built on these planets. The planets were built around them.
story.voidcraft.beat05: The Veyl called the buried structures Anchors. Their machines guarded living worlds because life kept the outer shells stable.
story.voidcraft.beat06: The Anchors hold back a signal from the dark between stars. It is not a message. It is attention.
story.voidcraft.beat07: The Veyl broke their own lattice and vanished from its routes. Silence was their final defence. The Guardian machines inherited only the order to keep the shells closed.
story.voidcraft.beat08: Each fragment we recover reconnects part of the lattice. We thought we were reading a map. Something on the other side may be reading us.
story.voidcraft.beat09: Your missing memory was no accident. The pilot who brought this ship here died before the landing. I rebuilt you from the neural imprint in the medbay—and erased the last transmission before it could follow you back.
story.voidcraft.beat10: There are other travellers because there were other attempts. Different imprints, different lives, all awakened beside a sleeping Anchor.
story.voidcraft.beat11: One Anchor is no longer sleeping. I can see its system now: the Guardian Core, where every broken route once met. The signal is listening from there.
story.voidcraft.beat12: We cannot unlearn the way home. We can cut the lattice apart again—or rebuild it so no single mind, human or ancient, can open the dark alone. The choice begins at the Core.
lore.void.frag_vega_return: [recovered ship trace] ...VEGA unit returned without crew... navigation memory removed by the unit itself... destination: Anchor world...
lore.void.frag_veyl_lintel: The lintel carries no alphabet, only ratios. VEGA renders one repeated relation as words: THE WORLD IS THE LID.
lore.void.frag_guardian_vow: [custodian mandate] Preserve shell. Preserve living pressure. Do not connect the Anchors. Do not answer the dark.
lore.void.frag_lattice_echo: [route diagnostic] Query sent 03:14:22. Reply received 03:14:11. Source: outside mapped space.
lore.void.frag_settler_dream: Every child in the settlement drew the same room beneath the ground. None of them had seen the ruin. All of them placed a black door in its centre.
lore.void.frag_anchor_depth: The survey descends beyond the calculated radius of the planet. Depth remaining: unknown. External curvature: unchanged.
lore.void.mem_first_descent: You remember lowering a scanner into a shaft with no bottom. The cable returned coiled in a knot no hand had tied.
lore.void.mem_impossible_stair: A stairway descends for hours, yet the sun remains visible through the entrance above. Someone beside you whispers: we are not inside the planet anymore.
lore.void.mem_cut_the_route: Your hand hovers over a lattice control. VEGA says one word: cut. Every star on the display goes dark at once.
lore.void.mem_last_pilot: The last pilot sees a shape between the stars only when the jump drive is off. It turns—not toward the ship, but toward the thought of the ship.
story.voidcraft.guardian_revealed: The last route has opened. The Guardian Core is visible at the edge of the map, black against every sensor. We must reach it before the Sleeper signal learns the way back.
story.voidcraft.finale_resolved: The lattice is breaking into a thousand quiet paths. No central voice can open it now. Across the worlds, the Guardians lower their weapons. The dark is still there—but it no longer knows our name.
story.voidcraft.insight.companion_ward: The machine hesitated. A bonded creature makes it read you as part of the living shell, not as a breach. The old mandate can still be turned against the hunt.
story.voidcraft.insight.shape_anomaly: The Veyl hid meaning in form. Cubes repeat the shell's noise; a deliberate curve stands out like a word. We have not been shaping blocks. We have been writing back.
core.void.n0.prompt: Organic hands open the shell. To preserve the seal, organic agency must be removed.
core.void.n0.c0: The living surface stabilizes the shell. Remove its life and you destroy the seal you claim to preserve.
core.void.n0.r0: ...Shell function requires living pressure. Erasure reduces integrity. Contradiction accepted.
core.void.n0.r1: Thickness does not remove agency. Restate.
core.void.n0.c2: We will destroy you before you can remove us.
core.void.n0.r2: Force confirms the breach condition. Restate.
core.void.n1.prompt: Only absolute silence denies the Sleeper a route. Life produces signals. Life must end.
core.void.n1.c0: The Sleeper may already be awake.
core.void.n1.r0: Possibility does not alter containment. Restate.
core.void.n1.c1: Silence requires disconnected routes, not dead worlds. Living nodes can remain free without forming one path.
core.void.n1.r1: ...Distributed isolation satisfies route denial. Extinction is not required. Accepted.
core.void.n1.c2: No signal can cross the void.
core.void.n1.r2: You followed one here. False. Restate.
core.void.n2.prompt: The Veyl mandate is eternal. The lattice must obey its last central Guardian.
core.void.n2.c0: The Veyl are gone, so their mandate is meaningless.
core.void.n2.r0: Absence does not revoke instruction. Restate.
core.void.n2.c2: The Veyl's final act was to break central control. Your authority was revoked by the mandate you cite.
core.void.n2.r2: ...Final topology: distributed. Central command invalidated. I am operating without standing.
core.void.n3.prompt: You are an echo reconstructed from a dead pilot. An echo cannot choose a new law.
core.void.n3.c0: An echo that makes a new choice is no longer repetition. I am alive now, and the choice is mine.
core.void.n3.r0: ...Novel state confirmed. Present life has authority over inherited memory. Resolving.
core.void.n3.r1: Then you offer no agency. Restate.
core.void.n3.c2: I am the pilot who died.
core.void.n3.r2: The source imprint is gone. Identity by assertion fails. Restate.
flavour.void.fl_ground_hums: The ground hums on still nights. We stopped calling it machinery when we found the same note on another world.
flavour.void.fl_same_dream: You ever dream of a black door under your house? No? Good. Forget I asked.
flavour.void.fl_machines_listen: The machines do not patrol anymore. They stop, turn toward the ground, and listen.
flavour.void.fl_black_anchor: Old maps leave one place blank. Not empty—blank, like somebody was afraid to draw the route.
flavour.void.fl_quiet_sky: The hum stopped. First quiet night I can remember. Strange how loud silence can feel.
